title: Agent availability: Set Busy toast but card stays available, repeated toasts

root_cause_analysis.backend: PUT /crm/agents/:id in src/routes/api.js omitted routing_status, weight, and max_concurrent_leads from the allowed fields map, causing updateAgent() to receive an empty object and persist zero changes.
root_cause_analysis.frontend: public/js/app.js did not disable the toggle button during request execution, allowing repeated rapid clicks, and re-fetched the unchanged agent workload which reverted the card to available.
root_cause_analysis.permissions: Agents with role 'agent' were blocked by requireManagerOrAdmin from updating their own routing status.
